## Summary

I resolved ticket T-3008 by identifying that the clickhouse-2 pod is stuck in ContainerCreating due to a storage array limitation, not a Kubernetes problem. The Corvane storage array's host group has reached its maximum LUN mappings (512), preventing the volume from being mounted. I provided the ticket owner with clear guidance to contact their storage team to clean up unused LUN mappings, after which Kubernetes will automatically retry and the pod should start successfully.
